package audience

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	signalmodel "github.com/viant/datly/transcribe/testdata/castmodel"
)

func (r *AudienceRow) OnFetch(context.Context) error {
	if r.InclusionMap != nil || r.ExclusionMap != nil || r.Signals != nil || r.Nested != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("transient maps must not be scanned from SQL")
	}
	r.InclusionMap = map[string][]string{"include": {"a", "b"}}
	r.ExclusionMap = map[string][]string{"exclude": {"c"}}
	r.Signals = map[signalmodel.Signals][]*signalmodel.Signals{{Label: "key"}: {nil, {Label: "kept"}}}
	r.Nested = map[string]map[int][]string{"group": {1: {"value"}}}
	r.Computed = len(r.InclusionMap["include"]) + len(r.ExclusionMap["exclude"])
	// Keep maps populated so the test proves tags, not clearing, hide them.
	return nil
}
